subject: Use the fetched TLS and TCP ports in clusterProcessGossipSection (#2761)
reason: The change only replaces inline ternary expressions in clusterProcessGossipSection's address-update condition with the msg_tls_port/msg_tcp_port variables already computed by getClientPortFromGossip a few lines above. Those variables are defined by exactly the same expressions that were removed (tls_cluster ? ntohs(g->port) : ntohs(g->pport) for TLS and the reverse for TCP), and the gossip entry is not mutated in between, so the condition evaluates identically on every input. This is a pure refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
